w10_P4_000201: A robotic arm carriage of mass 15000 grams moves along a rail 2.5 m long, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 2t^3 + 0t^2. The drive must supply the force that produces the carriage's acceleration at t = 1 s, plus 20 N of rail friction, and this drive force is expressed in kN. Three identical carriages run on 3 identical rails at once. What total drive force, in kN, do the 3 rails require?
w10_P4_000202: A pneumatic sorting machine flicks parcels of mass 98000 grams along a chute. Each parcel's acceleration in m/s^2 equals the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 11. The machine flicks 12 parcels at once, each with the force that produces that acceleration. On top of the combined flicking force the machine's frame also carries 19 N from a return spring, then 29 N from the chute's guide rollers, and then 14 N from a sensor bracket. What total force, in N, does the frame carry?
w10_P4_000209: A lab-bench air track carries a glider of mass 12000 grams. The glider's speed in m/s is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 30 = 0. Its energy of motion at that speed is measured, then 30 J from a launch spring is added, and then 5 J lost to air drag is subtracted. Express the resulting energy in kJ.
w10_P4_000211: A monorail service cart of mass 45000 grams runs along a straight beam 120 m long, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 2t^3 - 6t^2. The beam's anchor must resist the force producing the cart's acceleration at t = 3 s, which the depot records in kN, plus 23 kN of static preload. There are 7 identical anchors under identical loads along the line. What total anchor load, in kN, does the depot record?
w10_P4_000213: A cargo sled of mass 59 kg is pulled across ice on a course 400 m long. Its speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 13x + 42 = 0. The sled's energy of motion at that speed, less 14 J lost to runner friction, is written into the log in kJ. The logger then adds 20 kJ for the energy in the sled's fuel cell and subtracts 15 kJ reserved for the return leg. What figure, in kJ, ends up in the log?
w10_P4_000214: A 3000 gram drone is calibrated on a test range. Its flight speed in m/s is 6 more than the area under the curve y = 5x^2 + 8x between x = 0 and x = 2. Four identical drones fly at that speed in a group. What is the total energy of motion of the 4 drones, in kJ?
w10_P4_000221: The figure a range officer needs, in kJ, is the net energy of a volley: the gross energy of the volley expressed in kJ, minus 12 kJ absorbed by the backstop, minus a further 1 kJ dissipated in the sabots. The volley consists of 6 identical projectiles, each of mass 7 kg and length 0.4 m, every one carrying the same energy of motion. The projectiles' speed in m/s equals the number of ways of choosing 2 firing lanes out of 11. What net energy, in kJ, does the officer record?
w10_P4_000225: The number a quarry engineer must report, in kN, taking the direction of travel as positive, is the resultant on a skip: the drive load, minus 24 kN of brake force acting against travel, minus a further 18 kN of cable drag acting against travel. The drive load, expressed in kN, is the force producing the skip's acceleration plus 1 N of bearing friction. The skip has a mass of 65000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 4x^2 + 4x between x = 2 and x = 3. What resultant, in kN, does the engineer report?
w10_P4_000232: The final reading a lab wants, in J, is the tally after adding 8 J from a charging coil to an intermediate figure. That intermediate figure is the combined energy of motion of 2 identical carts, less 29 J lost to friction. Each cart has a mass of 59000 grams. Each cart's speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 4x between x = 0 and x = 1. What final reading, in J, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000240: The figure a workshop supervisor wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is 3 times the per-shift energy balance of a test bench. The per-shift balance is the combined energy of motion of 4 identical trolleys, expressed in kJ, minus 16 kJ consumed by the bench's hydraulic pump. Each trolley has a mass of 12 kg and a wheelbase of 0.8 m. The trolleys' speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 247 and 317 exactly. What figure, in kJ, does the supervisor record?
w10_P4_000242: A vehicle-crash lab fires sleds of mass 172000 grams along a rail 45 m long. Each sled's acceleration in m/s^2 is 27 less than the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 8x between x = 1 and x = 4. Each sled is pushed by the force that produces that acceleration. A rack holds 3 sleds, a bay holds 12 identical racks, and the lab has 10 identical bays, all firing at once. What total push, in N, do all the sleds receive together?
w10_P4_000248: A freight-elevator counterweight of mass 93000 grams moves along a vertical guide, and its position in metres after t seconds is s(t) = 1t^3 - 2t^2. The guide must transmit the force producing the counterweight's acceleration at t = 3 s, plus 18 N of rail friction, minus 19 N of relief from a balance spring. There are 5 identical guides under identical loads in the shaft. What total force, in N, do the 5 guides transmit?
w10_P4_000254: A pitching machine on a training ground fires heavy training balls of mass 18 kg at a net 22 m away. Each ball's speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 2x between x = 2 and x = 4. The machine logs each ball's energy of motion in kJ. It fires 5 balls in a set, and the net's dampers absorb 9 kJ per set before the rest reaches the backstop. How much energy, in kJ, reaches the backstop per set?
w10_P4_000255: The figure a lab wants, in N, is the total load on a bench clamp: the combined push on 5 identical carts plus 7 N from a retaining spring. Each cart has a mass of 6000 grams and rides a rail 1.5 m long. The push on each cart is the force that produces its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is 2 less than the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 6x + 8 = 0. What total load, in N, does the clamp carry?
w10_P4_000257: A courier depot has 8 loading bays and counts every way of choosing 2 of them for a shuttle route; that count is used as the shuttle speed in m/s. Each shuttle has a mass of 46000 grams and a length of 1.6 m. The depot records each shuttle's energy of motion in kJ. A route runs 4 shuttles, and the depot runs 11 identical routes. A flywheel store adds 16 kJ to the grand total. What grand total, in kJ, does the depot report?
w10_P4_000260: A robot lawnmower's position along a straight lane, in metres, is s(t) = 5t^3 + 5t^2 with t in seconds. Its speed at t = 1 s, reduced by 7, is used as the launch speed in m/s of a 32000 gram test sled on a track 9 m long. The sled's energy of motion at launch is measured; a batch is 8 identical sleds, and a latch spring adds 6 J to the batch total. What is the batch total, in J?
w10_P4_000263: A test trolley of mass 33000 grams moves along a bench 2 m long. Its speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 361 and 13 exactly. The trolley's energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 17 kJ of stored battery energy is added to it to give one trolley's energy budget. A rack holds 10 such trolleys and the lab has 7 identical racks. What is the total energy budget, in kJ, of all the trolleys?
w10_P4_000266: The figure a test-track manager wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is the session balance: the gross session energy expressed in kJ, minus 26 kJ consumed by the track's launch motor. The gross session energy is 3 identical runs, each run being the energy of motion of a 27 kg sled plus 15 J released by its brake spring. The sled's speed in m/s is set equal to the acceleration at t = 2 s of a pace car whose position in metres is s(t) = 1t^3 + 4t^2 with t in seconds. What session balance, in kJ, does the manager record?
w10_P4_000271: The number a dockside crane operator logs, in kN, is the total for 3 identical hoists, each hoist's load being the pull on its container plus 29 kN of static rigging load. The pull, expressed in kN, is the force producing the container's acceleration. Each container has a mass of 123000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 10 times the largest whole number that divides both 357 and 311 exactly. What total, in kN, does the operator log?
w10_P4_000273: The value a launch-control team wants, in kN, is the grand total net thrust: 8 identical pads, each pad holding 10 identical sleds, each sled's net thrust being its drive thrust (expressed in kN) minus 5 kN of rail drag. Each sled has a mass of 163 kg and a length of 3 m. The drive thrust is the force producing the sled's acceleration, and that acceleration in m/s^2 equals the number of ways of choosing 4 booster cartridges out of 7. What grand total net thrust, in kN, does the team report?
w10_P4_000277: The number a tram depot wants, in kN, is the total on a traction mount: 12 kN of static load plus the combined drive force of 8 identical bogie pairs, each pair being 2 identical bogies. Each bogie has a mass of 190 kg, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 5t^3 - 2t^2. The drive force on each bogie, expressed in kN, is the force producing its acceleration at t = 1 s. What total, in kN, does the depot report?
w10_P4_000279: A catapult sled of mass 162000 grams runs along a track 50 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 7 times the sum of 2 and 9. The sled's launch fitting must carry the force producing that acceleration plus 22 N of rail friction, and the fitting load is expressed in kN. A relief valve then takes 1 kN off the fitting load. What load, in kN, remains on the fitting?
w10_P4_000280: A lab bench drives a slider of mass 17000 grams along a rail. The slider's acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 268 and 99 exactly. The force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN, and 6 identical sliders share the bench under identical drive. To the combined drive force the bench frame adds 23 kN of clamping load, and a counterbalance then relieves 15 kN. What net load, in kN, does the bench frame carry?
w10_P4_000291: The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is a final tally: an intermediate energy figure plus 10 kJ from a heater plus 15 kJ from a storage battery. The intermediate figure is the combined energy of motion of 4 identical carts, expressed in kJ. Each cart has a mass of 19000 grams. Each cart's speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 0x between x = 1 and x = 2. What final tally, in kJ, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000297: A delivery robot of mass 39000 grams travels at a speed in m/s equal to the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 13x + 40 = 0. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 26 kJ of battery reserve is added to give one robot's energy budget. A fleet of 7 identical robots has the combined budget, from which 25 kJ is subtracted for the charging dock's overhead. What is the fleet's net energy budget, in kJ?
